family.description: This protein family, specific to Chlamydiales, includes CT_584 from Chlamydia trachomatis, a type III secretion system (T3SS)-associated protein. This protein shows a four alpha-helix bundle at the N terminus, a three-stranded antiparallel beta-sheet, and two alpha- helices arranged in a kinked antiparallel manner at the C terminus [[cite:PUB00100879]].
family.name: CT_584-like
